# shipd_snapshot_webhook (Resource)

A Convex destination for snapshot.published events. An environment can have one destination. Destroy deletes the destination. To configure a new receiver, create the webhook with enabled set to false, rotate the signing secret in shipd, and save it in the receiver’s secret manager before enabling delivery. Terraform state contains the destination URL and omits signing secrets. Use shipd for test sends, delivery history, and redelivery.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shipd_snapshot_webhook" "convex" {
  environment_id = "your-environment-id"
  url            = "https://your-deployment.convex.site/shipd/webhook"
  enabled        = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Owning environment ID. Changing it replaces the webhook.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) HTTPS Convex callback URL ending in .convex.site without user information or a fragment. Terraform stores the complete URL in plan and state. Use a URL without credentials.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether delivery is enabled. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable webhook ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shipd_snapshot_webhook.convex ENVIRONMENT_ID/DESTINATION_ID
```
